No payment is taken until you approve the plan. Common questions

On this walk you study layered worship spaces and commerce in a living district.

The date, start time, pace and language are arranged to suit your group.

What it covers

  • Market/temple precinct introduction
  • Architectural exteriors and streets
  • Craft and commercial life
  • Living heritage reflection

How the time is spent

  1. Market/temple precinct introduction 20 min

  2. Architectural exteriors and streets 35 min

  3. Craft and commercial life 45 min

  4. Living heritage reflection 30 min

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

By the end you can

  • Describe how worship spaces and markets are layered in the Bhuleshwar precinct.
  • Read architectural exteriors and streets as evidence of a living district.
  • Explain how craft and commercial life sit alongside religious heritage in daily use.

You take away

An interpretation sheet with questions to ask on site and suggested reading.
